purpose: untouched host and insertion-source evaluation after development is complete
candidate_generator_sources: TRIT corpus from CAD for Assurance; archive versions, host independence, license and witness traces pending audit
admission_rules: Pin host revision, source files, generator revision, insertion parameters and synthesis flow before graph construction
Reject exact or structurally duplicated development hosts; group derivatives by host and generator
Verify clean and benign functional equivalence under an explicit oracle or bounded protocol
Verify an attainable Trojan trigger and an observed payload difference with saved stimulus, trace and output witness
Verify mapped graph hashes, node order, source lineage, and survival of inserted and benign logic
Require benign additions matched on mapped graph size and broad gate statistics; measure remaining size and generator shortcuts before model scoring
Quarantine ambiguous behavior, missing clean counterpart, and failed graph correspondence
Freeze admitted manifest, model checkpoint selection, size bins, primary metric, uncertainty method and exclusions before first prediction

scoring.inference_input: single suspect graph, no clean twin, generator ID or host ID
scoring.primary: equal-host within-host AUROC on admitted clean, benign and Trojan circuits
scoring.comparison: paired host-bootstrap difference against size-only baseline, two-sided 95% interval

claim_boundary: No untouched-test performance or independent-generator generalization claim until admission and a frozen first evaluation are complete
